story.skyabyss.opening.p1: Long ago, the sky and the earth kept a promise.
story.skyabyss.opening.p2: In the sky flew an old thing that dragged the moon behind it.
story.skyabyss.opening.p3: Deep under the earth beat a heart that held the world in place.
story.skyabyss.opening.p4: The heart split its beat in four and gave it to the titans.
story.skyabyss.opening.p5: The titans sang, and kept the moon away. People built towns upon their backs.
story.skyabyss.opening.p6: On the ground, the Skywatch family rang their bell and watched the sky.
story.skyabyss.opening.p7: ...No one rings the bell now. And the moon is drawing near again.
story.skyabyss.opening.p8: On a nameless island, a traveller wakes.
story.skyabyss.opening.p9: "Write it down before you forget. So that next time, you notice sooner."
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_whale.p1: The capital's storyteller remembered the titans' old songs.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_whale.p2: They say a whale of stone swims the sky above the northern hills.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_whale.p3: In Kujirami, someone still chases the whale.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_whale.p4: On the pass, someone had walked before you, packed just the same.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_whale.p5: Deep in the whale's back, a borrowed heartbeat sounds.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_tide.p1: When its heart stopped, the stone whale fell into a deep sleep. It is not dead.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_tide.p2: From deep within, one fragment of the Sky Key. Three more remain.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_tide.p3: Across the eastern sea goes a turtle whose shell is an island.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_tide.p4: Long ago, on the night the sky nearly fell, people fled onto the titans' backs.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_tide.p5: Why did they choose to live upon those backs?
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_storm.p1: The tide shell, too, sank into sleep beneath the sea.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_storm.p2: Over the western peaks wheels a bird clad in thunder.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_storm.p3: The wind folk's book recorded the same visitor, again and again.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_storm.p4: From a hill in the night, someone is watching.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_storm.p5: The shadow in the mirror turned a moment too late.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_ember.p1: The thunder wing, too, folded its wings and slept.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_ember.p2: The three fragments point faintly downward.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_ember.p3: In the southern wastes, a titan of fire swims beneath the ground.
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_ember.p4: A page at the old forge: "Return all four, then go down. This time, for sure."
story.skyabyss.chapter_titan_ember.p5: Perhaps stilling a heart is not the same as killing.
story.skyabyss.moon_core_end.p1: The core's eye closed, and the three rings that bound time came undone.
story.skyabyss.moon_core_end.p2: The four of me smiled, and returned to the light.
story.skyabyss.moon_core_end.p3: The rewinding has stopped. The moon will never turn back to before the fall.
story.skyabyss.moon_core_end.p4: ...And still, the moon does not stop falling. Above it, the shadow of vast wings passed by.
story.skyabyss.moon_core_end.p5: On the ground, the bell rings. From above the clouds, the Pilgrim descends.
story.skyabyss.finale_ascend.p1: The sleeping titans opened their eyes at the same dawn.
story.skyabyss.finale_ascend.p2: Four shadows gathered above the bell tower.
story.skyabyss.finale_ascend.p3: On the stone whale's back, the city fell away beneath you.
story.skyabyss.finale_ascend.p4: The thunder wing broke through the clouds. Light poured over everything.
story.skyabyss.finale_ascend.p5: Above the sea of clouds floated an island with a broken gate.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_calm.p1: When you laid your hand on the seat, light passed through the clouds and down into the depths.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_calm.p2: The loosened heart began, slowly, to beat in time again. Sky and earth drew on one another once more.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_calm.p3: The titans' song could be heard again.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_calm.p4: The moon drew away and the sky cleared. The city's bell announced the morning.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_calm.p5: My former selves, their promise kept, returned to the light.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_break.p1: You struck the seat and cut the chains that bound the Pilgrim.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_break.p2: The heart in the depths shattered, and the pull between sky and earth came undone.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_break.p3: The Pilgrim was sealed away beyond a crack in the sky.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_break.p4: The titans sank into a deep sleep. They sing no more.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_break.p5: Even beneath the broken sky, people light their lamps. The world goes on, changed.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_accept.p1: You left the seat empty, and invited the Pilgrim down to the earth.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_accept.p2: For the first time, the Pilgrim came down beneath the clouds. ...Its whole form stayed hidden in light.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_accept.p3: The moon it had dragged was freed of its chains, and came to rest quietly high in the sky.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_accept.p4: The city's bell fell silent. No one need watch the sky any longer. A wing circles the daytime sky.
story.skyabyss.finale_end_accept.p5: My former selves rode the wing beyond the sky. Past the promise, and further still.
